summary: The diff implements most of the required comment system functionality across backend and frontend. REQ-1 (Comment type + stable storage), REQ-2 (backend functions), REQ-3 (React Query hooks), REQ-4 (CommentSection component), and REQ-5 (PostCard integration) are all addressed. However, some specific acceptance criteria have gaps: stable storage persistence is not clearly verified from the diff, getCommentLikeCount is not confirmed implemented, anonymous principal rejection is not confirmed, and the Report option in the three-dot menu is not visible in the truncated CommentSection code.

missing_requirements.reason: The backend/main.mo diff is truncated and does not show the stable var declaration for comments. The migration.mo file handles migration logic only. Cannot confirm stable storage is used.

missing_requirements.reason: The backend/main.mo is truncated and there is no evidence in the diff summary or visible code that getCommentLikeCount is implemented.

missing_requirements.requirement: All functions require an authenticated caller (not anonymous principal)
missing_requirements.reason: The backend/main.mo is truncated and there is no visible evidence of anonymous principal rejection checks in the comment functions.

missing_requirements.requirement: The three-dot menu shows Report to users who are not the author
missing_requirements.reason: The CommentSection.tsx is truncated and the Report option visibility logic is not confirmed in the visible portion of the diff.
